messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Dutch, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Dutch line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Velen zijn de dieren waarmee zij trouwt, en er zullen er nog meer zijn, tot de hond zal komen, die haar zal laten sterven van verdriet.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Italian → Dutch)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|------------------|--------| | Molti | many (quantifier) | Velen | many | OK | | son | are (copular) | zijn | are | OK | | li | the (definite article) | de | the | OK | | animali | animals (noun) | dieren | animals | OK | | a | with (preposition) | waarmee* | with which | OK | | cui | which / whom (relative pronoun) | waarmee* | with which | OK | | s'ammoglia | she wives (verb) | trouwt | weds | OK | | e | and (conjunction) | en | and | OK | | più | more (comparative) | meer | more | OK | | saranno | shall be (future) | zullen … zijn | shall be | OK | | ancora | yet / still (adverb) | nog | still | OK | | infin | until (subordinator) | tot | until | OK | | che (101) | that (conjunction) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | ’l | the (definite article) | de | the | OK | | veltro | hound (noun) | hond | hound | OK | | verrà | shall come (future) | zal komen | will come | OK | | che (102) | that (relative pronoun) | die | that | OK | | la | her (pronoun) | haar | her | OK | | farà | will make (causative) | zal laten | will cause | OK | | morir | die (infinitive) | sterven | die | OK | | con | of (preposition) | van | of | OK | | doglia | grief (noun) | verdriet | grief | OK |
\*The Dutch word **“waarmee”** simultaneously expresses the preposition “with” (a) and the relative pronoun “which/whom” (cui); therefore both Italian tokens map to the same Dutch form.
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** `che` (line 101) – the Italian conjunction “that” has no counterpart in the Dutch clause “tot de hond”.
All other source tokens are accounted for and correctly rendered.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Dutch script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Dutch text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 100** - Original: Velen zijn de dieren waarmee zij trouwt, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 101** - Original: en er zullen er nog meer zijn, tot de hond - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – double “er”; **UNNECESSARY** – internal comma (not present in source) - Corrected: en er zullen nog meer zijn tot de hond
- **Line 102** - Original: zal komen, die haar zal laten sterven van verdriet. - Issue: none (internal comma removed to match “no internal punctuation” rule) - Corrected: no change
```text Velen zijn de dieren waarmee zij trouwt, en er zullen nog meer zijn tot de hond zal komen die haar zal laten sterven van verdriet. ```
